# Daft multimodal and AI functions

This page maps 63 Daft names onto their Batcher spellings, grouped by the class or module they live on. Each row reads in both directions. {doc}`index` explains the statuses and the waves.

To rewrite Daft code onto these spellings, run the codemod:

```bash
python -m batcher.migrate --from daft --to batcher <paths>
```

Replace `<paths>` with the files or directories to rewrite. This direction is implemented. Without `--write` the command prints a diff and changes nothing, and `--write` applies it.

## `Expression`: image, video, audio, file, and AI functions

The following table maps the 25 names on `Expression`, sorted alphabetically.

| Daft | Batcher | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `convert_image` | `Expr.image.convert` | mismatch | Differs: Daft operates on its decoded Image logical type; Batcher's .image accessor reads and re-encodes encoded image bytes (PNG by default), so inputs and outputs have different types. Needs an Image logical type. Wave W12. |
| `crop` | `Expr.image.crop` | mismatch | Differs: Daft operates on its decoded Image logical type; Batcher's .image accessor reads and re-encodes encoded image bytes (PNG by default), so inputs and outputs have different types.
